headline: SoFi Stock Climbs on Strong Lending Surge and Earnings Beat
summary: SoFi Technologies shares rose after a surge in lending drove an earnings beat and an optimistic early outlook that impressed Wall Street.
why: SoFi is a digital financial services and lending platform whose quarterly performance signals consumer credit health and digital banking demand.

impacts.name: SoFi Technologies
impacts.why: Better-than-expected earnings and a robust lending surge directly improve investor sentiment and share valuation.

why_moved: An earnings beat driven by surging loan volume directly signals stronger-than-expected financial performance, boosting investor confidence.
